changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23. The 60-day emergency moratorium (26-1049, effective June 23, 2026) lapsed around Aug. 22, 2026, but Council gave unanimous third and final reading to the three companion 180-day ordinances (26-1050 Solar, 26-1051 BESS, 26-1052 Data Centers) at its Aug. 11, 2026 regular meeting, per the county's own posted minutes, so the pause on new permits for solar, BESS, and data-center facilities has run continuously and is now due to run to roughly 2027-02-07. Separately, the county's Land Use Committee and Planning Commission continued work in August-September 2026 on permanent, non-moratorium data-center zoning standards (OA-26-01), which received first reading Sept. 8, 2026 and had not been adopted as of this date.
